item.title: EC full bench to visit Assam from Feb 16 to review poll preparedness
item.description: Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar, along with Election Commissioners Sukhbir Singh Sandhu and Vivek Joshi, will visit Assam from February 16–18

item.title: AGP confident of NDA’s return in Assam, seat-sharing talks yet to begin: Atul Bora
item.description: AGP president Atul Bora confirmed that formal seat-sharing discussions with the BJP ahead of the Assembly polls are yet to begin.

item.title: Mizoram to get piped natural gas by early 2028, Aizawl and Mamit first in line
item.description: Consumers are likely to begin using piped natural gas as the Tripura-Mizoram Gas Pipeline Project progresses.

item.title: Youth dies after assault in Digboi, five arrested, protests erupt
item.description: Protestors blocked NH-38 at the Chariali Bazar market area in Digboi, disrupting vehicular traffic & demanding immediate action

item.title: Silghat jute mill crisis deepens; experts allege mismanagement behind shutdown
item.description: The crisis has been attributed to either the non-payment of dues to suppliers or ulterior motives by some stakeholders

item.title: Moran ELF emerges as strategic asset for defence readiness & flood relief operations
item.description: The Emergency Landing Facility will enhance national security preparedness and infrastructure growth in Upper Assam, says Chief Minister Himanta Biswa Sarma.

item.title: Crop damage by monkeys forcing villages to stop farming: CM Sarma
item.description: Chief Minister Himanta Biswa Sarma highlights growing monkey menace destroying crops across the state, saying several villages have stopped farming due to losses.

item.title: Forest Man Jadav Payeng calls for hands-on environmental education
item.description: The Asomiya Suraksha Mancha conferred at Tezpur its newly instituted Asom Nakshatra Award on Jadav Payeng recognising his lifelong contribution to environment

item.title: Tea workers protest demanding repeal of labour codes across Brahmaputra Valley
item.description: The protest was organised under the directive of the Assam Chah Mazdoor Sangha (ACMS), the recognised affiliate of INTUC
